rationale: The plan uses a negative-binomial Wald model with explicit reference level and contrast, matches the unpaired 6v6 single-batch design, and cross-validates with edgeR QL as a stated secondary method. QC precedes testing with library size, detected genes, blind VST PCA and distance heatmap, and a pre-stated depth-alone-is-not-exclusion policy with a required structural reason plus a with/without sensitivity analysis. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and tied to group size; normalization is strictly internal to DESeq2/edgeR (median-of-ratios, TMM) with no pre-scaling. BH at 0.05 is used with apeglm shrinkage kept alongside unshrunken estimates and thresholds applied only at the test stage. Enrichment is full-list fgsea preranked on the Wald statistic against staged Hallmark (version reported) with explicit universe and 15-500 size window, ORA correctly avoided given the gene count. The final report bundles versions, formula, contrast, thresholds, DE/enrichment counts, caveats, and reproducibility record as required.
